features: PIMS "Workshop elicitation (D5.2)" page: several workshops per project, each with a ranking poll on a -5 to +5 or 1-4 scale for importance, feasibility or long-term impact (WS-10).
11-tenet rating with the D5.2 Annex 4 guiding questions; anonymous participants enter answers through a form or an xlsx/csv template (WS-10).
Workshop results view and xlsx export (WS-10).
Per-measure write-back of the tenet results into the Response register with Undo and a TenetSource note (WS-10).
Tenet guiding questions verified against D5.2 Annex 4 (WS-10).

medium: Register tenet levels are validated: values outside the allowed levels, and 'intermediate' on any tenet other than ecological effectiveness, are cleared on load (1.32.1).
Workshop participants with duplicate ids in a hand-edited file are renumbered instead of being deleted together (1.32.1).
Workshop apply records survive removing a measure from the workshop, so Undo still works after the measure is put back (1.32.1).
Adding a second stakeholder, engagement, communication or response measure created duplicate rows (since 1.16.5).
Scenario Builder impact analysis crashed on scenarios that remove a link.
Added links failed to bind to baseline edges that carry extra columns.
performance: ML connection suggestions: batch graph-feature extraction computes paths, neighbours and centrality once per call instead of per pair; 2000 pairs on a 200-node network went from 35 s to 0.2 s with identical output (1.26.1).
high: Auto-save backups wrote empty fields without null, so recovery could drop a whole element category; the loader now binds rows by key union, so older backups recover too (WS-4).
low: Workshop export: tenet point columns read '1 = Completely disagree' ... '5 = Completely agree'; Lithuanian 'Label' header corrected (1.32.3).
Workshop and readiness xlsx files: column headers and labels in the user's language; the answers sheets keep their code headers so they can still be imported (1.32.2).
Response register title corrected in German, Lithuanian, Norwegian and Greek (1.32.2).
Workshop participants with an unknown entry source show an empty source instead of a missing-label code (1.32.2).
Workshop page: translated yes/no and 'n' labels; no space before colons; the import refusal names the file's own column headers (1.32.1).

migration_notes: Projects that use a WP5 indicator are stamped min_app_version 1.24.0; 1.23.0 and older would drop the indicator columns on save.

Projects with an intervention-designer scenario that re-weights links (links_modified) are stamped min_app_version 1.28.0; 1.27.0 and older would ignore the re-weights and show the scenario as unchanged.
Projects with stakeholders saved by 1.30.0 (or with Policy_Target) need app 1.30.0; older apps cannot add stakeholders to the 14-column register.
Projects with readiness answers need app 1.31.0.
